name: calendar-manager
description: Eight agents run Paul's calendar SOP from cloud routines: conflicts, commute and travel blocks, Legend colors, notes, 1:1s, invites missing from his calendar, holds on times he offers by email, and working location and out-of-office that follow him around the world. Time-zone strict. Clef classifies, never Claude. Writes come from riley@cheek.org; they learn from Paul's answers in a private memory repo. A hook blocks deletes, invites (Callie excepted), RSVPs, messages and edits to the past.
